title: UAAP: NUNS girls complete elims sweep to claim Finals berth
summary: National University-Nazareth School is headed to the Finals of the UAAP Season 89 girls' volleyball tournament after completing a sweep of the elimination round on Sunday at the Blue Eagle Gym.
